title: Close the Track 1 identity and admission blockers before paper orders
verdict_reason: I-1, I-2 and I-3 are all closed: global_nkd declares the rule it runs, the sizing basis was measured on both sides and the route aligned to the basis its published numbers were admitted under, and the params hash now covers the tradable identity, point value, tick and sizing basis. Signal reproduction is unchanged and still exact. B1 still blocks orders. Paper orders remain blocked by the operational items from Stage 5Q-7, none of which is an identity question.

part_a_i1.why_the_code_was_right: the committed MNKD artifact reproduces exactly under NormalR4Params(ema_period=10) — 228 / 31 / 26 rows across floor, vault2025 and vault2026
part_a_i1.also_repaired: four SOURCES entries still described legacy NKD ('MNKD keeps 2.5', 'the promoted MNKD sleeve keeps it on', 'MNKD unchanged at 14:00 JST')
part_a_i1.checkpoints_invalidated_evidence: replay_checkpoint.track1.json does not exist; the legacy global_index/replay_checkpoint.json holds zero params_hash entries

part_b_i3.method: the committed candidate stream run through the real Track1Book twice, changing nothing but risk_dollars; no gate re-implemented

bases.artifact_basis: 2.5 x daily ATR x point_value x qty (ROSKA4_MULT / NKD_MULT)
bases.true_stop_distance: |entry - stop| x pv x qty = 2.0 x daily ATR x pv x qty

part_b_i3.second_mechanism: process_instant sorts same-instant candidates by risk high-first, so shrinking two sleeves and not the other two reorders the queue; three of the moved rows are Calm A, whose own risk never changed
part_b_i3.decision: keep artifact_basis for the two ATR-stop sleeves and ALIGN THE LIVE ROUTE TO IT
part_b_i3.decision_reason: every published Calmar, MaxDD and net figure was measured under it; switching is a re-rate, not a refinement — vault2026 takes 7 more trades for $2,388 less

peak_cap_usage.gross_formula: max(long, short) / account — what MultiClusterGuard.admits and family_verdict both use

instrument_failures_found_and_fixed.what: the first harness summed long+short and reported peak roska4_swing gross 0.0903 against a 0.050 cap
instrument_failures_found_and_fixed.caught_by: a usage figure above the cap the guard enforces is impossible by construction
instrument_failures_found_and_fixed.fix: max(long, short), plus SC6 asserting the bound rather than trusting it

instrument_failures_found_and_fixed.what: a settlement detector sampled inside _book, before settle_due removes the position from the book, so it could never observe the change it was looking for
instrument_failures_found_and_fixed.consequence: two instrumentations disagreed and neither was published until the disagreement was resolved

net_overshoot_explained.observation: two windows show a NET peak above the 0.044 cap, on BOTH bases
net_overshoot_explained.verified: zero admissions and zero forced closes ever leave roska4_swing net above cap; the peak is reached at an unrelated instant after a scheduled close
net_overshoot_explained.meaning: the cap gates NEW RISK; it is not an invariant of the book afterwards, and nothing can un-take a position because another one closed

sources.tradable_symbol: Contract.ibkr — the same attribute ibkr_broker._RAITS_TO_IBKR is built from, read one step earlier so the two cannot disagree
sources.tick: the same Contract record; slippage is already hashed as ticks-per-side, so tick SIZE decides what that costs

concrete_case_now_caught.what: MNKD orders routed to the full-size NKD contract at ten times the intended size
concrete_case_now_caught.measured: -$1,400.00 at the broker against -$140.00 in the sleeve ledger, exactly 10.0000x
concrete_case_now_caught.before: moved no params hash at all
concrete_case_now_caught.after: moves two fields; rp.diff names them

part_c_i2.signature_defect_found: sleeve_config(sleeve, inst, ...) has always taken `inst` and until 2026-08-24 never used it — the instrument reached the hash only through the data path
part_c_i2.consequence: the four R4 instruments no longer share one identity with the data pinned; pin the CONTRACT as well and they collapse again, and the Stage 2 test now asserts both halves

tests_changed.why: I-2; the parametrised mutation test then covers them automatically

Stage 5Q-5 added spy_refresh_pm; second copy of the same stale literal

global_index/track1_params.py: four new identity fields and their SOURCES (I-2)
global_index/track1_live_source.py: the two proxy sleeves size through tp.risk_dollars and record the basis they used instead of a literal (I-3)

live_behaviour_change.what: roska4_swing and global_nkd candidates now report risk 25% larger than this morning
live_behaviour_change.effect: the live route will admit FEWER positions — the conservative direction, and the one that matches the measured book

spy_refresh_pm and --repair-boundary are source-only; the restart was blocked
the legacy route still fetches MNKD bars through the order map
the NKD window leaves the Tokyo band after 2026-11-01
